purpose: Engineering resolutions of the import-manifest vs in-file-header findings of tools/crt_runtime_notices.py (Tranche 10). Each entry is bound to the SHA-256 of the file as reviewed: a change to the file reopens the finding. This is an engineering comparison against upstream, not legal advice; legal sign-off of the inherited-runtime notices is a separate publication gate.

entries.license: Lucent Technologies permissive notice (David M. Gay, netlib gdtoa), as carried by the gdtoa files that include it
basis: Neither upstream copy has a header: it is an 18-line include fragment (the Honor_FLT_ROUNDS block), not a stand-alone work.
The same block, with the same comment text, appears inline in headed Lucent-licensed gdtoa files of this tree (libc/src/gdtoa/dtoa.c, strtod.c); it is netlib gdtoa code.
It is included only by libc/src/gdtoa/strtof.c, which carries the Lucent notice.

entries.license: FreeBSD msun, no license text in the file upstream; the FreeBSD files it ships with in this tree carry fdlibm and BSD-2-Clause headers
basis: Three lines (two #include directives and the definition `int signgam = 0;`); the upstream file has no header either.
Redistributed unmodified as part of FreeBSD msun via Bionic; it is attributed to that origin and not claimed as project-owned.
Whether a three-line definition needs a separate license text at all is left to the legal review.
